message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients you’ll need:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no-boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz can (or 2 cups) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning or dried basil & oregano | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh parsley or basil (optional) | handful, chopped |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated (optional) | ¼ cup |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil | 1 Tbsp, chopped |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All-purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated) | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Optional: extra fresh basil or parsley | for garnish |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the meat sauce**: Sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, seasonings, and simmer for 20–30 min.
2. **Prepare ricotta mix**: Combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
3. **Make béchamel**: Melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk while whisking until thickened; season with nutmeg, salt, pepper.
4. **Layer**: Start with a thin layer of meat sauce, then noodles, ricotta, béchamel, mozzarella, and repeat. Finish with mozzarella and Parmesan on top.
5. **Bake**: Cover with foil (to prevent sticking, spray foil with cooking spray), bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
